title: dieteria canescens var. incana
intro: Dieteria canescens var. incana, commonly known as Woolly Groundsella, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Woolly Groundsella include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, and its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that can also exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer properties.
